mechanism: Nicotine increases lithium clearance through increased renal perfusion and sodium excretion, potentially reducing lithium levels; nicotine also increases sympathomimetic effects and may worsen tremor and cardiovascular effects when combined with lithium.
action: Monitor lithium levels closely in patients who smoke or use nicotine products; counsel on smoking cessation as it may require lithium dose adjustment; baseline and periodic serum lithium concentrations recommended.
